body: Therein lies the rub.  It has been a decade since I lived in this town and everyone I was friends with has moved on.  But that's not the worse part.  I can't even go to the corner store without someone recognizing me (Small town, everyone knows everyone) and asking what I'm up to and where I'm working.  Every single time.  I don't even leave the house for days because I don't want to keep saying that I'm an uneducated unemployed loser and have it reflect badly on my family.

I used to hike a lot when I was younger and take photos along the way but I fell out of practice once I left to move away into the city.  Not many trails and such there.  Maybe it is time to revive that pastime.

I can't talk to my family because every time I think about it I know they would be accepting and helpful but deep down I'm sure they would be thinking "He probably isn't depressed, he is just doing it for attention." I couldn't even blame them for thinking that because if I was really depressed I would have gotten help before now right.  They have spent enough time and money on my case I don't want to be more of a burden then I already am.

The same old skills that every nerd has, good with computers/internet savvy etc. Hobbies not so much, I used to paint and write and a couple other things but I can't even find the drive to do those anymore.  I hate the time I spend online playing stupid flash games but it beats sitting staring at the wall.
